content: Vedant Thakur contacted Neha Kapoor regarding an unexpected increase in his revised quote's premium. Neha explained it was due to a lower deductible and roadside assistance, which Vedant noted he did not request. Neha apologized for the mistake, agreed to remove the rider, and sent a corrected quote. Vedant also requested and received a digital insurance card for his new car and inquired about his next payment due date, which Neha confirmed is 01/09/2027.

action_items: Remove the roadside assistance rider from the quote
Send the corrected quote to the customer
